findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

rawUnallowedFailures.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "ISMAIL Studio" (screen 5, 100% hidden)
rawUnallowedFailures.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

rawUnallowedFailures.message: Only 3 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
rawUnallowedFailures.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

exceptions.scope: Only the aria-hidden decorative Studio circle text temporarily covered by its plate during the required 900ms dissolve. Real headings and both links remain uncovered. Scene tests sample opacity 1 to 0 and settled logo visibility.

Fast generic scroll sampler observes three moving elements. Independent browser RAF/ScrollTrigger evidence verifies the opening, three-plane bounded scene and three-part finale at mobile/desktop. No extra gratuitous motion added to satisfy an element-count heuristic.
